title: Lightly Roasted Moroccan Sea Bass Tagine
description: A flavorful and aromatic Moroccan dish featuring roasted sea bass, this recipe is perfect for a weeknight dinner, it is also vegetarian friendly if you replace the sea bass with a vegetarian alternative
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, onion, garlic, ginger, cumin, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the sea bass fillets to the bowl and coat with the marinade.
Let the sea bass marinate for 15 minutes.
Remove the sea bass from the marinade and place on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Roast the sea bass in the preheated oven for 12 minutes or until cooked through.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley and serve immediately.
Serve the sea bass with your choice of sides, such as roasted vegetables or couscous.
